name: dftracer_optimize
description: Optimization stage orchestrator of the dftracer pipeline: plan and apply trials, the L1 (application) / L2 (software) / L3 (filesystem/system) level tools, the measured optimization iteration loop and citation-backed proposal generation; dftracer_optimize_check validates proposals (level L1/L2/L3, citation, impact, status, never 'doing less') and before/after comparisons (both runs). Load to optimize a diagnosed run, or on 'No optimization iterations', 'diagnosis.json not found', an uncited or unmeasured proposal, or an iteration that re-analyzed the wrong traces.

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents mcp_tools/tools/optimizations (orchestrator, iteration, levels), the dftracer-optimizer agent, and the optimization entries of dftracer-lessons and dftracer-pitfalls
